comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Same model: builds and sells single-family and attached homes to first-time, move-up and active adult buyers, with title and mortgage services.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Same core business of building and selling detached and attached homes to first-time and move-up buyers, with mortgage and title services; build-to-rent is a side line.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to first-time and move-up buyers, with in-house mortgage and title services.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Develops raw land into finished lots and sells them to homebuilders (B2B); it does not build or sell homes to consumers.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to first-time, move-up and retirement buyers, with in-house mortgage financing.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Builds and sells detached homes and townhomes to first-time, move-up and active adult buyers, with mortgage, title and insurance services.
